why_strengthened: GB_{C,s} = the exact GB template formula GB_C (gram_b_r2; base flags --order 8 --quantum 12345 --ngeneric 0 --p4 1 --sb2 --g5 plus the 42 own-GB-name template units) with header clause count +126 and the 126-clause M_s tail appended: the at-most-one binaries not(g_s((0,c),(i,0))) or not(g_s((0,d),(i,0))), i=2..7, 1<=c<d<=7, on monomial/Gram support square s. GBBINDING (d917203d...c673) decodes every appended literal and binds all 22 byte identities.

soundness.argument: Accepted bridge (GB necessity r2 b9b4a595..., genuine NF r1 1a352d36..., erratum r2 a2d3b9b3...): for five genuine MOQLS(8) in the accepted U/T16 normal form, actual Gram support values with canonical GB auxiliaries satisfy GB_C for their template C. For C in {P1-B1,P1-B2,P1-B3,P1-B5}, genuine moves Q'_(tau(s))(rho(i),sigma(j)) = P_sigma Q_s(i,j) preserve row-0 form, SB2, the Q1 witness, SAME template and ROWLEX keys and yield a permutation support matrix in a representative square s in {2},{2,4},{2},{2,3} respectively; a permutation support matrix satisfies all 126 M_s binaries. Hence the moved genuine configuration satisfies GB_{C,s} for some representative s, and parent-qualified UNSAT of every GB_{C,s} with s in the representative set of C excludes genuine normalized configurations in C. Scope: genuine level only (not a transformation of arbitrary Boolean GB models; not equivalence to GA; no import of GA auxiliaries); n=8 still needs the final parent composition verdict.
